notes.title: Ahro V2.0 The Body & Spirit Update is coming in November!
notes.content:
[p]Marking the 1 Year anniversary of the release of Ahro, we're happy to announce that [b]Ahro V2.0, The Body & Spirit Update is coming in November![/b] It will include:[/p][list][*][p][b]New breakdown options (for easier gameplay)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]New colors options to customize your spirit tail[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Bug fixes[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Ahro on Linux (via Steam)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Ahro soundtrack for purchase (on Steam)[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Ahro Print Edition Lorebook for purchase[/b][/p][/*][/list][p]Stay tuned for more![/p][p]

notes.title: Ver. 1.2 Update
notes.content:
[h3][b]Ver 1.2 update includes small but useful improvements, including hints that may help players in the third and forth levels.
[/b][/h3]

[b]Updates include: 
[/b]
Level 2
Added door enter arrow to improve compass room door discoverability

Level 3
Added door enter arrow (and purple glow) to improve compass room door discoverability

Level 3
Added new "zoom to hint targets" hint sign and functionality

Level 3 & 4
Decreased herb regen cooldown time in a few places (so herbs reappear sooner)

Level 4
Added hint arrow number indicators that help players know in which order they should attempt to fly to destinations

Plus small bug fixes

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41513101/45a77c7d299e3e76694a541bcddf3cc4430ab582.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Release Window Update
notes.content:
[i]SEPTEMBER 2023 UPDATE: 
AHRO WILL NOW BE RELEASING IN 2024! FOR REAL THIS TIME!
[/i]

Hey everyone! Just wanted to post an update that work continues on Ahro with a planned Steam release  sometime next year! Stay tuned for more news in the coming months. In the meantime here’s a GIF! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41513101/e9dd246526c78fe333de78cddcc97755f8510ad4.gif[/img]

Can Ahro continue avoiding his darkness? 
Perhaps this adage could be useful, [i]"wherever you go, there you are"[/i].
